title: Conductor board
description: The goal conductor's at-a-glance board. Needs you comes first. The goal and compact progress stay visible. Task rows, round and update time start inside a disclosure. Ordinary task summaries and chat notes stay out of the page; a worker question or blocker's short summary appears only beside its Needs-you action, and a rejected task keeps its short reason. Goal, round and task state come from the work fold. Closed tasks omitted from the fold window still count through forgotten. needs_you is the conductor's short list of actions only the person can take.

upkeep.means: one short line per thing the person must do or decide, in the person's language
upkeep.when: whenever an item starts or stops waiting on the person
upkeep.how: write the whole list each time, and drop a line once it is done
